newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-BENFICA STRUGGLE TO 1-0 WIN OVER LOKOMOTIV.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BENFICA STRUGGLE TO 1-0 WIN OVER LOKOMOTIV.

text.p: A sluggish Benfica struggled to overcome Lokomotiv Moscow 1-0 on Thursday in a second round European Cup Winners' Cup match and may regret a series of missed chances when they travel to Russia for the return leg.
Joao Pinto put Benfica in front with a close range goal in the eighth minute but the Lisbon side failed to make their clear superiority count when it came to scoring.
In a scrappy match, Benfica lacked the speed and penetration to break down a resolute Lokomotiv who spent most of the game pinned back in their own half.
Joao Pinto could do no better than drive the ball against goalkeeper Sergei Ovchinnikov when given a clear run on goal in the opening minutes of the second half.
Several more fine saves by the Russian denied an increasingly anxious Benfica a two-goal advantage to take to Moscow in a fortnight's time.
